newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Losses to major issues pull Slovak SAX to year-low.
newsitem.headline: Losses to major issues pull Slovak SAX to year-low.

text.p: Losses to shares of bank VUB and oil refiner Slovnaft on Wednesday pulled the Bratislava Stock Exchange's SAX index to a year-low.
VUB lost 60 crowns to close at 1,440, a drop of 5.4 percent, while Slovnaft fell 12 crowns to 807 as the SAX dropped 1.31 points to 166.01.
Floor trading was listless with only 27,797 shares changing hands, and brokers predicted little change for the bourse in the coming days.

"There is very little going on and there is no news that would give an impulse to an upswing," said Libor Briska of Creditanstalt. "At present I can just see the SAX heading down," he said adding the floor could be as low as 160.
The Bratislava bourse has been hard hit in recent months by a lack of liquidity as investors, put off by a murky market and political fears have waited on the sidelines.
With direct and block trades figured in, volume of shares traded was 1,653,456, up from Tuesday's 418,050 while turnover rose to 1.6 billion crowns, up from 76.47 million.
